text.body: praṇamya paramānandaṃ svātmānaṃ parameśvaram | advaitaśatakaṃ vakṣye sarvavedāntasaṃgraham ||1|| jñaptirūpo mahādevo svecchayā dehamāviśan | jīvātmeti śrutau prokto deho māyeti saṃjñitaḥ ||2|| tasmād dṛśyamayo deho dehi dṛg rūpa ucyate | evaṃ dṛg dṛśyarūpeṇa saṃsthitaṃ bhūtamaṇḍalam ||3|| vinā dehena jīvātmā kiñcit kartuṃ na śaktimān | vinā jovena deho'pi jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ na śaktimān ||4|| tasmāttādātntasaṃbandhaṃ prāpto dehena cetanaḥ | dehohamiti niścitya karmāṇi kurute sadā ||5|| vapuścaturvidhaṃ proktaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vivekinām | sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇañca sāmānyañceti nāmabhiḥ ||6|| saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmavivekinām | sāmānyadeharahitam trividhaṃ vapurūcyate ||7|| jāgare sthūladehasyāt sūkṣmadehaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | svapne, suṣuptau dehaśca kāraṇākyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||8|| dṛśyarūpamidaṃ sarvaṃ deha ityābhidhīyate | tatravyāptaṃ paraṃ jyotirdehoti parigīyate ||9|| ayaṃ sāmānya dehasyāt manuṣyāṇāṃ vivekinām | sāvasthā hi turoyārakhyā bhuvaneṣu sudurlabhā ||10|| yadā sāmanyadehe'smin sthitiḥ puṃsābhijāyate | tadā yogīśvaro vedaiḥ paramātmeti gīyate ||11|| yadā sthūlādideheṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ sthitirbhavet | jīvātmeti tadā proktaḥ saṅkocagrahaṇād budhaiḥ ||12|| ayaṃ jīvo hi saṃsāre sadā'sāre paribhraman | lokāllokāntaraṃ gatvā garbhapātraṃ viśātyasau ||13|| gatvā garbhagṛhād bhūyo mānuṣaṃ lokamāviśan | putro'yaṃ mama bhāryeyaṃ asmadīyamidaṃ dhanam ||14|| idaṃ gotramidaṃ mitraṃ asmadīyamidaṃ gṛham | iyaṃ mātā mama pitā janā ete mamārayaḥ ||15|| iti niścitya jīvātmā rāgadeṣaṃ dine dine | etān prati karotyeva svājñānādeva kevalam ||16|| ekarūpasya devasya sarveṣāmantarātmanaḥ | vyomavad vyāptadehasya bodharūpasya sarvadā ||17|| kutracid dṛśyarūpasya māyādīnāṃ parigrahāt | sarvasyādhārarūpasya meghādhīnāṃ yathā nabhaḥ ||18|| saccidānandarūpasya brahmarudrādikalpanāt | vibhāgaṃ kurute jīvaḥ svā'jñānādeva kevalam ||19|| vyāptarūpasya devasya saṅkocaṃ duḥkhameva hi | tadeva jīvaḥ kurute svā'jñānādeva kevalam ||20|| atha satyavihīnānāṃ kāmināṃ kāmacāriṇām | svadharmavimukhānāṃ ca saṃsargaṃ kurute sadā ||21|| punarvaśyāvaśo sthitvā taissārdhaṃ śvakharāgavat | sarvadharmavinirmukto deho tā eva sevate ||22|| ālāpe hariṇākṣīṇāṃ darśanasparśanādiṣu | hāsabhāvavilāseṣu manaḥ samyaṅ nimajjati ||23|| viṣayagrahaṇājjantoḥ pradveṣa upajāyate | mātaraṃ pitaraṃ putraṃ vṛddhañcānyajanān prati ||24|| alabdhaviṣayo jantuḥ cintayā paritapyate | śokamohabhayakleśakrodhalobhādhiyuktayā ||25|| labdhe tu paramaprīti saubhāgyaśatasaṃyutam | abhiprāyaśataṃ dhyātvā viṣayeṣu viṣajyate ||26|| alabdhaviṣaye labdhe jantuḥ śreyo na labhyate | evaṃ viṣayagarteṣu parimajjati mānavaḥ ||27|| sampādya mitraṃ jīvātmā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ dine dine | mameti manyate nityaṃ janmāntarakṛtāśrubhāt ||28|| prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ bhuktiṃ kurvan dehi dine dine | pauruṣeṇa prayatnena karmāṇi kurute sadā ||29|| saṃsāre vartamānānāṃ puṃsāṃ tenaiva hetunā | śrubhāśrubhāni karmāṇi dvividhanīti sanmatam ||30|| śrubhāśrubhāni karmāṇi pauruṣāṇi na cedyadi | vedānāṃ vidhivākyānāṃ vyarthatvaṃ bhavati dhruvam ||31|| na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni na kuryādahitaṃ satām | evamādīni vākyāni vyārthanyeva vicāraṇe ||32|| anyathā vidhivākyāni pravartante tu kaṃ prati | jīvaṃ prati pravṛttiścet so'pi karmavaśānugaḥ ||33|| karmānusāri jīvaśca karmāṇyevānuvartate | tasmāddhi karmāṇi kṣīṇe tasya mṛtyurbhaved dhruvam ||34|| ye mūḍhā dvividhaṃ karma nāṅgīkurvanti mohataḥ | teṣāṃ hi maraṇaṃ mokṣo lokāyatikavaddhruvam ||35|| sthūladehaṃ gṛhītvaivaṃ anubhūya śubhāśubham | pauruṣaṃ sūkṣmadehena bhoktumārabhate punaḥ ||36|| sthūladehāt sūkṣmadehavyāvṛttiṃ maraṇaṃ smṛtam | jīvānāṃ mṛtikāle'smin sūkṣmadehaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||37|| prārabdhakarmāṇāṃ nāśāt upabhogena cetanaḥ | sthūladehāt sūkṣmadehavyāvṛttiṃ kurute'vaśaḥ ||38|| yathā svapne sthūladehāt sūkṣmadehasthitirbhavet | mṛtikāle tathā pusāṃ sūkṣmadehasthitirbhavet ||39|| yat karma kurute svapne sūkṣmadehena cetanaḥ | sthūladehena jīvātmā tadeva kurute tadā ||40|| sthūladehaṃ vihayaivaṃ gṛhītvā sūkṣmavigraham | svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vā'pi jīvātmā parigacchati ||41|| jīvātmā puṇyabāhulyāt svargalokaṃ yathākramam | vikāsayati bhogārthaṃ svarūpe svena catesā ||42|| viśuddhaṃ jñānamevaikaṃ yathā svapne tridhā bhavet | grāhakagrahaṇādhyaiśca svargaloke tathā bhavet ||43|| yadyat svapnaprapañcasya copādānaṃ svayaṃ bhavet | svargasya narakasyaiva upādānaṃ svayaṃ bhavet ||44|| jīvātmā liṅgadehena svargaṃ narakameva vā | gatvā manomayaṃ paścādanubhūya śubhāśubham ||45|| praviśya kāraṇaṃ dehaṃ paripūrṇaṃ manomayam | mahat sukhamavāpnoti parityajya pariśramam ||46|| vihāya kāraṇaṃ dehaṃ svātmajñānamayādbhutam | śuklārteve susaṃśuddhe garbhapātre prabuddhavān ||47|| punargarbhagṛhādbuddhvā śuddhaśuklārtavaṃ tadā | upādhitvena saṃgṛhya dehameva kilecchati ||48|| garbhapātre sthitaṃ kurvan bahvabhadrāvahaḥ pumān | mūrcchāvasthāṃ gṛhītvādau janmāntarasubhāśubhāt ||49|| pravāhato'nādimayaṃ dehameva punaḥ punaḥ | dhyātvā dhyātvā kālavaśāt deha eva prajāyate ||50|| upādhitvena saṃgṛhya sthitaśśuklārtavaṃ yadā | dehaṃ vinā sthiyasyāsya kathaṃ dhyānaṃ bhavettadā ||51|| bodhamātraikarūpasya devasyānandarūpiṇaḥ | svasvarūpe'paricchedyā māyā syāt pārameśvarī ||52|| jñaptirūpasya devasya jñaptirūpo'hameva hi | iti jñānavihīnasya bodho māyeti kathyate ||53|| evaṃ vicāraṇe māyā daivīti parikalpitā | tayā saṅkocamāttasya bandho'nādirihocyate ||54|| anādhyantavatī māyā sthitā māyāvicāraṇe | carācaramidaṃ viśvaṃ tatkāryatvāt tathā bhavet ||55|| ata eva hi devasya saccidānandarūpiṇaḥ | saptayoniṣvahaṃbhāvastatra tatra dṛḍhaṃ bhavet ||56|| lokeṣu vartamānānāṃ puṃsāṃ tena ca hetunā | dehaṃ vināpyahaṅkāro vartate vāsanāvaśāt ||57|| vṛkṣabīje yathā vṛkṣo sthitaśśākhādisaṃyutaḥ | tathāhami sthito deho hastapādādisaṃyutaḥ ||58|| tasmād garbhasthitiṃ kurvan jībo'vidyādisaṃyutaḥ | ahaṅkāravaśādeva deha eva prajāyate ||59|| dehi sampūrṇadeho'sau janmāntaraśubhāśubhāt | punargarbhagṛhād gatvā mūrcchāmāpa suvismitām ||60|| evaṃ dehatraye kurvan sthitiṃ dehi paribhraman | jīvātmetucyate sadbhiḥ sarvavedāntapāragaiḥ ||61|| evaṃ saṃsarataḥ puṃsaḥ svenārjitaśubhāśubhāt | deśikālokanādeva vairāgyaṃ jāyate hṛdi ||62|| evaṃ vairāgyayuktasya puṃso hṛdi nirantaram | āvirbabhūva śuddhātmā vicārassoyamīdṛśaḥ ||63|| dhanena duḥkharopeṇa durlabhenātmamṛtyunā | puṃsāṃ kā prītirevasyāt pāparūpeṇa sarvadā ||64|| kiṃ me gehena kiṃ bhogaiḥ kiṃ dhanaīrdhanadairapi | kiṃ mitrabāndhavaīḥ kāryaṃ sarva kālavaśādasat ||65|| kiṃ striyā pāparūpiṇyā kiṃ putrairbhandahetukaiḥ | mṛtyunā gṛhyamāṇasya taiḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||66|| atītā bahavaḥ putrāḥ dārā janmani janmani | prārabdhakarmabhoktṛṇāṃ puṃsāṃ kimiha taiḥ phalam ||67|| bhāveṣvaratiyuktasya puṃsassatyārthabhāṣiṇaḥ | ko'haṃ kathamidañceti cintā syāt suvhiśāradā ||68|| sā cintā deśikaṃ vipraṃ vedaśāstrāgamānvitam | brahmajñānavatāṃ puṃsāṃ varaṃ ghaṭayati kṣaṇāt ||69|| śaktipātapavitro'yaṃ jīvātmā guruvigraham | dṛṣṭvā paravaśo bhūtvā natiñcakai punaḥ punaḥ ||70|| natvā devaṃ mahātmānaṃ deśikaṃ karuṇāmayam | svasvarūpaṃ parijñātuṃ prāñjalistamabhāṣata ||71|| svarūpaṃ paramānandaṃ jñātubhicchāmi deśika | saṃsārābdhititīrṣūṇāṃ karṇadhāro'si dehinām ||72|| iti pṛṣṭo viraktena śiṣyeṇa paramārthavit | svasvarūpaṃ pāṃ dhyāyan deśikastamabhāṣata ||73|| yamāśritya pravartante janāssarve nirantaram | svarūpamiti taṃ vidyāt karaṇaiścakṣurādibhiḥ ||74|| jāgrat‌kāle yamāśritya sthūladehaḥ prabartate | sūkṣmadehastathā svapne svarūpaṃ taṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||75|| suṣūptau tu yamāśritya bhāsate kāraṇaṃ vapuḥ | svājñānamayamavyaktaṃ svarūpamavadhāraya ||76|| yo jāgradādibhedena mithyārūpeṇa bhāsate | teṣāṃ draṣṭṛsvarūpeṇa sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||77|| sa eva tvaṃ śivo viṣṇuragnirindracaturmukhaḥ | sa eva sūryassomaśca saḥ śāstā sa vināyakaḥ ||78|| vāṇī śrīgirijā durgā devī cetyādināmabhiḥ | vibhidya procyate prājñairmatibhedena nānyathā ||79|| ekarūpaṃ samāśritya saṅkalpañca vikalpakam | yadā karotyasau dehī mana ityucyate tadā ||80|| saṃśayaṃ parityajya rūpaṃ pratyavadhāritaḥ | yasmin kāle pratyagātmā buddhirityucyate tadā ||81|| yadā'sau svaparāmarśād idamitthamiti sphuṭam | rūpaṃ prati vijānāti tadāhaṅkāravān bhavet ||82|| yadā hastaḥ kara iti bāhoḥ paryāya eva hi | manobuddhirahaṅkāraścittaṃ ceti tathātmanaḥ ||83|| yathāvahnorvartibhedāt ikṣoḥ pākaviśeṣataḥ | nāmarūpātmako bhedaḥ sa tathā jīvasya nānyathā ||84|| yathā kṣīre ghṛtaṃ vyāpta tathyā dṛśye paraḥ pumān | upādhibhedāt bhedassyāt tasmādekasya nānyathā ||85|| ekarūpo mahādevaḥ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ | ekarūpo mahākāśo ghaṭādiṣu yathā sthitaḥ ||86|| pṛthak pṛthak sthitānāñca dehānāmavivādataḥ | pāṇipādādiyuktānāṃ bhedo nāsti vicāraṇe ||87|| carācaramidaṃ viśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmakaṃ smṛtam | dehānāṃ pañcabhūtānāṃ bhedo nāsti tathāsthite ||87|| mṛnmayatvād ghaṭādīnāṃ yathā bhedo na vidyate | pañcabhūtātmakatvena dehānāñca tathaiva ca ||89|| evaṃ vicāraṇe tāta nāsti bhedaḥ kadācana | dehānāṃ pañcabhūtānāṃ jaḍānāmāśunāśinām ||90|| navapradeśamātro'yaṃ hastapādādimānaham | iti niścayavān loke jīva ityabhidhīyate ||91|| sarvatra paripūrṇo'haṃ ayaṃ deho sameti ca | iti niścayavānantaḥ paramātmeti kathyate ||92|| evaṃ sthite na bhedassyāt jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | tayorabheda eva syāt citsvarūpāviśeṣataḥ ||13|| dehasākṣī prāṇa eva iti cettanna saṃgatam | suṣuptau sarvadehānāṃ jaḍatvādeva nānyathā ||14|| svavyāpārakṛte prāṇo dehoparatidarśanāt | dehasya kartā na prāṇa ityevamavadhāraya ||95|| yaccintyate bhūpatinā tat kurvantyanujīvinaḥ | tasmāt prāṇo na kartā syād iti lokeṣu darśanāt ||96|| dehatrayasamudbhūtāṃ vāsanāṃ saṃparityajan | parigṛhya paraṃ dehaṃ paripūrṇaṃ paro bhava ||97|| paripūrṇamayaṃ rūpaṃ parigṛhya śubhaśubham | nityanaimittikaṃ karma sadā kurvanna lityate ||98|| kṛtāni vāṅ‌ manaḥ kāyairloke karmāṇi jantubhiḥ | toṣāmanyatamatvena kathaṃ kartā bhaviṣyati ||99|| sarvatrāvasthitaṃ śāntaṃ svasvarūpābhidhaṃ śivam | anubhūya vapustyaktvā jñāptimātramayo bhava ||100||
